title: Feed and Water Supply Runway
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=feed:level
| stats latest(level_pct) as level, avg(daily_use_pct) as usage by silo
| eval days_left=round(level/usage,1)
| where days_left<7
| sort days_left
description: Estimates how many days of feed remain in each silo or bin so a delivery is ordered before the animals go hungry.
value: Running out of feed is not an option on a homestead; a usage-based runway makes reordering timely instead of frantic.
implementation: Ingest feed-level sensors into `index=personal`; schedule daily and flag supplies running low.
visualization: Table of feed silos by days of supply remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how many days of animal feed you have left, so you reorder before running out.
